title: Fort Beauséjour
scope: The surviving five-bastion earth enclosure of Fort Beauséjour–Fort Cumberland and its outer ditch, named stone foundations and grass-covered powder magazine.
limitations: Exposed masonry courses, stone color and the very small interior of the magazine are generalized. Only mapped present-day relics are represented. The detached museum building and wider park access are outside the fort model.
The historical plan establishes the enclosure’s identity. The terrain uses a contemporary bare-earth survey and the layout shows the ruins as they survive.
